mechanics.original_reminder: Whenever this deals combat damage to a player, you may have it become an Aura Curse until your next turn. Attach it to that player.
mechanics.executable_reminder: Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may have it become an Aura Curse enchantment with enchant opponent until your next turn. If you do, attach it to that player.

rule_text.name: 702.281a
rule_text.rule: Breach is a triggered ability found on some creatures. “Breach” means “Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, you may have it become an Aura Curse enchantment with enchant opponent until your next turn. If you do, attach it to that player.”

representative_cards.name: Mayar, Nullcrowned
representative_cards.original_text:
Mana cost: {U}{B}{R}
Type: Legendary Enchantment Creature — God
Power/Toughness: 3/3
Breach *(Whenever this deals combat damage to a player, you may have it become an Aura Curse until your next turn. Attach it to that player.)*
Recursive — As long as Mayar, Nullcrowned is a Curse, they have all nonrecursive abilities of other Curses and creatures with breach you control.
Pay 3 life: Target enchantment creature gains haste and menace until end of turn.
